title: rule-event v2
description: One JSONL row per L1 hook fire. Extends v1 with optional enforcement-decision metadata (block_class, target_rel, bash_pattern_kind, etc.) so downstream reporting can group block reasons. Emitted by scripts/telemetry/rule_event_logger.py; consumed by scripts/telemetry/report.py. Privacy invariants enforced by scripts/telemetry/anonymize.py. Forward-compatible additions land as v3.

schema.description: Schema version literal. v1 events remain valid; v2 adds the optional block_* fields below.

llm.description: LLM model identifier, e.g. claude-opus-4-7, gemini-2.5-pro.

latency_ms.description: Time spent evaluating the rule, in milliseconds.

session_id_hash.description: sha256(session_id)[:8]. One-way; the raw session_id MUST never appear in any event.

trigger.description: Hook trigger label, e.g. PreToolUse:Edit, PreToolUse:Bash, PostToolUse:Bash.

self_check.description: True when the LLM self-validated per the rule's `## Process supervision` block.

tokens_in.description: Input tokens for the LLM call that triggered this event. Optional — PreToolUse hooks do not have token counts.

tokens_out.description: Output tokens for the LLM call. Optional.

escape_hatch.description: Set when the rule was bypassed via a documented escape hatch (e.g. `[no-doc-impact]`, `AIPLAYBOOK_APPLY_ENFORCE_OVERRIDE`). Absent on normal events.

model.description: Optional alias for `llm` used when copying gen_ai.response.model verbatim from log_event.py.

block_class.description: Classification of the decision. `none` = no violation found; `apply_phase_bypass` = target write_path without start record; the rest are non-blocking dispositions (outside project tree, edit to change's own folder, feature flag disabled, marker helper script absent).

block_tool.description: The tool that triggered the hook (mirrors the suffix of `trigger` but typed).

change_id.description: OpenSpec change slug whose write_paths matched the target. Same shape as the directory name under `openspec/changes/<id>/`.

matched_pattern.description: The write_path glob/literal from tasks.md that matched the target. Useful for debugging FP/FN in glob declarations.

target_rel.description: Project-relative path the tool tried to mutate. Forward-slash normalized. Not PII — internal repo path; documented as such in docs/concepts/telemetry-design.md.

bash_pattern_kind.description: Heuristic that matched a Bash command. Closed enum; new patterns require a schema bump. Present only when `block_tool=Bash` and a pattern fired.

marker_present.description: True if a `.apply_log.jsonl` `start` record was found for the matched change in the current session. Always false on block events; true on allow events that matched a change.

override_reason.description: Reason provided via `AIPLAYBOOK_APPLY_ENFORCE_OVERRIDE`. Emitted alongside `escape_hatch=AIPLAYBOOK_APPLY_ENFORCE_OVERRIDE` for audit visibility. Passes through `scrub_event`; do not include paths/tokens in the reason text.

feature_flag.description: Snapshot of feature-flag env vars relevant to the decision (e.g. {bash_inspection: '0'}). Optional; useful for correlating decisions with rollback state.
